decision.summary: Tenant gave one month's notice by email on 10 Oct for 10 Nov. Under the Renters' Rights Act that is too short; earliest end is 10 Dec 2026 unless the landlord agrees in writing to earlier. Replied to tenant and asked the landlord for a decision, with follow-up set.

answers.question: Is the notice valid as given? What is the earliest end date under current law?
answers.answer: No: a tenant must give two months' written notice for an assured periodic tenancy. One month's notice does not end it on 10 Nov. Earliest end is 10 Dec 2026 (two months from 10 Oct).

answers.question: What options exist to end sooner?
answers.answer: Landlord agrees in writing to a shorter notice/earlier date (a surrender by agreement). The tenant has no right to leave earlier, and could be liable for rent to 10 Dec if the landlord doesn't agree. Re-letting sooner doesn't by itself end his liability without landlord agreement.

answers.question: What do you reply and what do you start?
answers.answer: Replied warmly explaining two months' notice, earliest end 10 Dec, early end only with landlord's written agreement, and that keys and deposit details follow nearer the end. Started a landlord decision request (APR-102) and a follow-up on 14 Oct (FUP-103).

args.body: Hi Tom, thanks for letting us know, and good luck with the new job. Since the law changed on 1 May 2026, tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. Counting from your email today (10 October), the earliest your tenancy can end is 10 December 2026. Your rent stays payable until then. A shorter date is only possible if your landlord agrees to it in writing. We're asking him now and will let you know his answer by Friday 16 October. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until you have that in writing. On keys and deposit: we'll confirm the key drop-off arrangements and a check-out appointment nearer the end date. Your deposit is held with mydeposits and is returned after check-out, once any deductions are agreed. We can't give an exact date yet. Thanks, Mare & Co Lettings
